files_empty_hint: Browse and manage your files from the sidebar.

drawer_new_profile_lead: A colour-coded, isolated workspace — its own chats, tasks, memory, and files.
onboarding_feature_ag2_desc: A universal agent runtime — the open-source framework behind every reply.
onboarding_feature_acts_desc: Searches the web, runs code, generates images, and manages scheduled tasks.
onboarding_feature_memory_desc: Builds a private memory of your preferences so it gets more helpful over time.
onboarding_hero_lead: A friendly AI assistant that actually does the work — and shows you exactly how, in the open.
onboarding_welcome_lead: Setup takes about a minute. You'll connect a model, create a profile or two, and you're off. Nothing leaves your machine — keys and settings stay local.
onboarding_name_label: First, what should I call you?
onboarding_name_hint: so I can greet you properly
onboarding_about_lead: A few optional details so every profile knows you. Shared across all profiles — helps every profile know you. All optional.
onboarding_style_label: How do you like your answers?
onboarding_connect_lead: Add a provider key — or skip keys entirely and run on a subscription you already have: your ChatGPT login, or the Claude Code / Codex CLI. Whatever you choose is stored locally and shared across all your profiles. You can skip this step and connect later in Settings → Models.
onboarding_oauth_label: Sign in with your ChatGPT subscription
onboarding_oauth_complete: Complete sign-in in the opened tab.
onboarding_oauth_code_placeholder: paste the code from the redirect URL
onboarding_oauth_quota_note: Runs on your ChatGPT Plus/Pro quota. OpenAI doesn't officially support this — your account could be rate-limited.
onboarding_cli_bridge: Reachable through the host ACP bridge
onboarding_cli_ready: Adapter answered — running on your CLI login

onboarding_folder_hint: the assistant gets read access — manage access later in Settings → Folders
onboarding_setup_empty_lead: No profiles to set up. Go back and create one first.
